wholePhysicalScope: The current named building footprint fixes all four sides. The public-domain historic view and restoration record establish the wrapping galleries and recessed solid core.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the wrapping arcade, paired colonnade, roof terrace and clay-tile jack roof.
limitations: Draft exterior: approximate photographic proportions and simplified ornament. It is not a survey, photogrammetric reconstruction or approved current geographic replacement.
Shown are the ground-floor open semicircular arcades, paired upper columns, dark timber doors, parapet and high center jack roof. The conservation record specifies limewash and clay tiles.
